title: Let's build a Chatbot - Design and Quality of Life Features (Part 13)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 13 of Let's Build a Chatbot in Blazor Server.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 Blazor Server 打造聊天機器人的第十三部分。

cues.en: Today's video has nothing really to do with AI or agent framework and so on, because I
cues.zh: 今天其實和 AI 或 Agent Framework 沒有太大關係，因為，

cues.en: mentioned in the past that this was not about being a perfect design and front end and so on.
cues.zh: 之前說過，這個系列不是追求完美的設計與前端。

cues.en: But I felt like at this point in time, we were with this design, and it needed a little fix up.
cues.zh: 但我覺得到了這個階段，目前的介面需要整理一下。

cues.en: It needed to look prettier, and it needed a lot of quality of life features.
cues.zh: 應該更好看，也需要許多改善使用體驗的小功能。

cues.en: So I went and did this as part of sort of the last parts of what we'll do with the Blazor Server.
cues.zh: 因此把這些工作安排在 Blazor Server 部分的後期。

cues.en: We're going to add some more settings, and then I think we're done and moving on to the next step in this series.
cues.zh: 之後再加入一些設定，應該就能告一段落，前往系列的下一階段。

cues.en: But what I wanted to do is I wanted to make this a little prettier, and in general, just quality of life.
cues.zh: 這次想讓介面更漂亮，整體使用體驗更好。

cues.en: So in order to do that, I wanted to use a design system, and the best design system I know for Blazor is the ModBlazor design system.
cues.zh: 為此想使用設計系統。我最熟悉、也覺得最好的 Blazor 設計系統，是 MudBlazor。

cues.en: I've used it a ton over time, but also I don't really want to go into design things here.
cues.zh: 以前用過很多，不過這裡不打算深入介紹設計。

cues.en: If you want, every single part of these have their own branch that you can go into, and you can check between main and speech.
cues.zh: 每個單元都有自己的分支，可以進入儲存庫，比較 main 與 Speech 等分支。

cues.en: You can see I've changed 40 different files in this and added 2,000 additions to the code.
cues.zh: 這次修改了四十個檔案，新增約兩千行程式碼。

cues.en: Let's say I didn't do it.
cues.zh: 不過應該說，不是我自己做的。

cues.en: It's mostly Codex who have done it over the last four hours.
cues.zh: 主要是 Codex 在過去四個小時完成。

cues.en: I have done various different changes and tweaks, and Codex, my favorite AI coding agent
cues.zh: 我提出各種調整與修改，Codex 是我最喜歡、

cues.en: that I can highly recommend is the one who have done most of this, because this is not about the design.
cues.zh: 也很推薦的程式開發代理程式，它完成了大部分工作，因為這裡不是在教設計。

cues.en: It's more about getting to a point where we actually feel it feels nice, despite that not being the main part of all this.
cues.zh: 而是想把介面改善到使用起來舒服，即使它不是系列主題。

cues.en: So I made this, I've done this, and also I wanted this to show that I think this has
cues.zh: 我也想藉此指出，這部分實際上，

cues.en: actually taken longer than all the rest of the series so far to figure out.
cues.zh: 花的時間可能比系列之前所有內容還長。

cues.en: It's roughly the same three hours or three, four hours to do, and that's because design
cues.zh: 大約同樣花了三到四個小時，因為設計，

cues.en: is a big part, a bigger part than the AI probably.
cues.zh: 是很大的一部分，可能比 AI 本身還大。

cues.en: So it is possible to do, but it's not the main part, so we won't go through every single file here in what we have done.
cues.zh: 當然做得到，但不是主要內容，所以不逐一介紹每個檔案的變更。

cues.en: That will take too much time and don't really give you anything.
cues.zh: 那會花太多時間，也未必對你有幫助。

cues.en: So I'm just going to show the end result and a little about the features I felt were missing,
cues.zh: 因此只展示最後結果，以及我認為缺少的功能，

cues.en: especially around quality of life, that you might also need to remember to put into your
cues.zh: 尤其是改善使用體驗的部分。你建立自己的，

cues.en: system when you build it, or if you want to just copy-paste this and get a chatbot more
cues.zh: 系統時也可能要記得加入；如果想直接複製，取得一套，

cues.en: or less out-of-the-box that actually can be used with a user, you also have that now.
cues.zh: 大致開箱即用、能讓使用者實際使用的聊天機器人，現在也有了。

cues.en: But enough delay, let's go in and see how it looks now.
cues.zh: 不多說，來看現在的樣子。

cues.en: So this is MudBlazer being used instead, looking roughly the same, but still we have gotten
cues.zh: 現在改用 MudBlazor，大致保留原本布局，但已經，

cues.en: rid of the sidebar over here, new design features, and MudBlazer is just a slightly prettier way.
cues.zh: 移除右側欄，加入新設計元素，整體更漂亮。

cues.en: So let's find a place where we use one of the tools.
cues.zh: 先找到有工具呼叫的對話。

cues.en: The tool calling looks a bit nicer.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫看起來更好一些。

cues.en: You can see the result here is now formatted and all kinds of things.
cues.zh: 可以看到結果已經格式化，也有其他改善。

cues.en: Let's go through case-by-case what I've done.
cues.zh: 逐一看看做了什麼。

cues.en: So one of the first things I put in was dark mode.
cues.zh: 首先加入深色模式。

cues.en: So now we can switch between light mode and dark mode.
cues.zh: 現在可以在淺色與深色模式間切換。

cues.en: This is something that comes out-of-the-box for MudBlazer.
cues.zh: 這是 MudBlazor 內建功能。

cues.en: I also changed these conversations over here, they are now sorted by the most recent at the top.
cues.zh: 也調整了對話清單，現在依最近更新排序，最新在最上面。

cues.en: They are not just buttons anymore, but actually a system where we can go in and either delete
cues.zh: 不再只是按鈕，還可以直接刪除，

cues.en: or rename the conversation as we wish to here.
cues.zh: 或重新命名對話。

cues.en: And if we don't want them anymore, for example this one, we can just say delete them.
cues.zh: 如果不再需要，例如這一段，直接刪除即可。

cues.en: So that is up and running.
cues.zh: 這項功能已經完成。

cues.en: Another thing we have done is we have taken all the sidebar over here and put it into a settings page.
cues.zh: 另一個變更，是把右側欄全部搬到設定頁面。

cues.en: So the same settings we had here before with streaming and image generation, instructions, and MCP servers here.
cues.zh: 原本的串流、圖像生成、自訂指示，以及 MCP 伺服器設定都在這裡。

cues.en: I've also taken in memories so I can go in and actually delete memories and add new memories without needing to talk via the client.
cues.zh: 也加入記憶管理，可以直接刪除或新增記憶，不必透過聊天操作。

cues.en: So that's also nice.
cues.zh: 這也很方便。

cues.en: We have moved the side-end user down here, and we have made this a slightly prettier system.
cues.zh: 登入使用者資訊移到下面，整體介面也更漂亮。

cues.en: Another thing we have done is that if there's images, we can now go into full-screen images if need be.
cues.zh: 另外，如果有圖片，現在可以視需要全螢幕查看。

cues.en: That is mostly when we go here and find an image and open it up so we can see it and
cues.zh: 例如找到一張圖片，點開後就能完整查看，

cues.en: not just the small images down here.
cues.zh: 不必只看下面的小縮圖。

cues.en: As mentioned, tool call results have now been formatted.
cues.zh: 如前面提到的，工具結果現在也有格式化。

cues.en: So if we look at the ones from my MCP server, it's now formatted here.
cues.zh: 例如我的 MCP 伺服器結果，現在會這樣顯示。

cues.en: And if this text is very long, we see a full request in here instead.
cues.zh: 如果文字很長，可以在這裡查看完整請求。

cues.en: Output, you can see is also being formatted now.
cues.zh: 輸出也已經格式化。

cues.en: Previously it was just raw text.
cues.zh: 以前只是原始文字。

cues.en: Now it's actually formatted as markdown using something called markdick, M-A-R-K-D-I-C-K.
cues.zh: 現在使用 Markdig，也就是 M-A-R-K-D-I-G，把 Markdown 格式化顯示。

cues.en: And things like, if we say thanks, for example, it actually moves down.
cues.zh: 例如說聲謝謝時，畫面也會自動向下捲動。

cues.en: And as we are generating, there is progress bar so we can actually understand what's going on in here.
cues.zh: 生成過程中會顯示進度列，讓使用者知道正在處理。

cues.en: Also you can see while we are generating right now, all the GUI has been locked down so we can't suddenly start something new.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，生成時所有介面控制項都會鎖定，不能突然開始另一項操作。

cues.en: You could argue that you needed to change that a bit and be able to start two threads
cues.zh: 當然，你可能想修改成能同時開啟兩段，

cues.en: at the same time and so on, but for now we've just closed it down so it doesn't go in and give problems.
cues.zh: 對話等做法，但目前先鎖定，避免互相干擾。

cues.en: So again, lots and lots of details, but nothing to do with the actual chatbot and AI in general.
cues.zh: 因此有很多細節，但都與聊天機器人的 AI 核心沒有直接關係。

cues.en: But I just felt like this was a nice needed upgrade in order to see a more polished version
cues.zh: 只是我認為，應該做這項升級，讓大家看到更完整、

cues.en: of what we can build with Agent Framework as a chatbot.
cues.zh: 更精緻的 Agent Framework 聊天機器人成品。

cues.en: So that's everything this time around.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些。

cues.en: There's a few more features that I want to build in, moving the settings to a real database
cues.zh: 還有幾個想加入的功能，包括把設定移到真正資料庫，

cues.en: and add some more settings to, for example, be able to bring your own API key and set
cues.zh: 再增加一些設定，例如使用自己的 API 金鑰，

cues.en: up what provider and different tools we are going to use behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 指定背後的供應商與不同工具。

cues.en: But that's for another video, see you then.
cues.zh: 這些留到其他影片，到時見。
